svg.title: Pest control technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as pest control technician, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A pump sprayer has a top plunger, tank, curved hose and separate spray lance. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
